item.title: Cypherock wants more Africans to use cold storage crypto wallets
item.description: Cypherock is bringing its sharded crypto hardware wallets to Africa, aiming to solve the risks of self-custody and lost keys. By splitting private keys across multiple devices and cards, the company offers a safer alternative to traditional wallets, targeting sophisticated traders, HNWIs, and exchanges. With plans for local warehouses and B2B partnerships, Cypherock hopes to overcome distribution challenges and tap into Africa’s fast-growing crypto market.
